check_valid_tensor: check a tensor for NaN or Inf values and log a warning if found
normalize_camera_extrinsics_and_points_b: normalize camera extrinsics and 3D points by centering on the first camera and scaling to unit average distance
transform_extrinsics_to_first_camera: transform camera extrinsics to a coordinate system centered at the first camera using closed-form inverse SE3
normalize_world_points_to_camera_frame: transform world points into the first camera's coordinate system using its rotation and translation
scale_points_and_depths_by_average_dista: scale world points, camera points, depths, and extrinsic translations by the average point distance
